From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>

Cc: qbr-facilitator@consultco.com

Subject: Q2 launch: Finalize OKRs, sign-offs & QBR readiness

Team —

We need a clean sign-off on the Q2 OKRs by EOD Tuesday so the Comm ops teams can lock the QBR deck and invite external stakeholders. I attached the consolidated OKR workbook with the edits from last week's leadership call. High-level asks: 

1) Each functional owner (see tab) please confirm target metrics and commit risks/mitigations.
2) Call out any dependency on Dedicated/Private feature rollouts that would change cadence.
3) Flag any items you want pulled into the QBR narrative — I expect 3 priority customer-facing wins and 2 operational risks.

Quick cadence:
- Today (Mon): owners review and add line-level comments in the workbook.
- Tue 12:00 PT: brief sync to resolve open items (15 min).
- Tue EOD: final approval from each owner.

I've looped in ConsultCo (cc) to help with the QBR facilitation if we want a neutral moderator.

Attachments: Q2_2027_OKRs_master.xlsx; QBR_Deck_Drafts_v3.pptx

Thanks — please mark approvals inline or reply with a single-line approval.

— Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Product, Redwood Inference

Vivek —

Thanks for the note. I reviewed the Growth tab and adjusted the success metric for Product-led signups (now 18% QoQ). Two quick calls-outs: 
- We will need an additional A/B cell allocation to validate the onboarding flow change — ops will take a small hit in week 2.
- The customer-facing win suggested: "5 new native integrations shipped" reads better as "3 integrations prioritized + 2 migration partners onboarded"; I updated the narrative.

Approve the Growth OKRs with these edits. I can join the Tue noon sync.

— Laura
